Hi Samantha / David —

Thanks again for taking time yesterday. Per our call, I wanted to capture the proposed success criteria, timeline, and an initial RACI so we can lock owners and schedule the kickoff. Please review and confirm or comment.

Summary of ask from ClearLake:
- Evaluate Redwood Inference for a 4-week POC to validate inference latency and cost for the patient-summary feature (internal-facing).
- Primary constraints: must run within ClearLake VPC, support PHI, provide audit logs for tokens and requests.

Proposed success criteria (high-level):
1) Latency: median 95th-percentile request latency < 250ms for 1-2 concurrent users with 1k token responses (on dedicated test pool).
2) Cost: demonstrable per-token cost <= target threshold (we'll model with Redwood Optimize recommendations).
3) Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence + audit logging enabled and KMS-managed keys in VPC.
4) Integration: sample integration with ClearLake staging app (API call + example prompt/template) and end-to-end test.
5) Data controls: data residency and retention policy confirmed in writing.

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (Mar 15): Kickoff and environment validation (VPC peering/connector, credentials)
- Week 1 (Mar 16-22): Deployment in ClearLake staging (private deployment or dedicated test pool)
- Week 2 (Mar 23-29): Load/latency tests and evaluation of cost numbers
- Week 3 (Mar 30–Apr 5): Integration tests and acceptance criteria verification
- Week 4 (Apr 6–12): Wrap-up, exec demo, and go/no-go decision

Initial RACI (please confirm external owners):
- Infra (VPC/networking): Responsible: ClearLake infra (David Cho) | Accountable: ClearLake infra | Consulted: Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood SE) | Informed: Rishi Malhotra (Sales)
- App integration (staging app): Responsible: ClearLake app eng (Samantha Lee) | Accountable: Samantha Lee | Consulted: Lauren Bishop (CS) | Informed: Marissa Cole (AE)
- Security & Compliance (SOC2, KMS): Responsible: ClearLake InfoSec (Daniel Park) | Accountable: ClearLake InfoSec | Consulted: Neha Kapoor (Redwood Security) | Informed: Legal/Procurement
- Procurement & Contracting: Responsible: procurement@clearlakehealth.com | Accountable: procurement | Consulted: Marissa Cole | Informed: Rishi Malhotra
- Redwood technical setup (runtime, model pinning, telemetry): Responsible: Vivek Kulkarni | Accountable: Vivek Kulkarni | Consulted: Neha Kapoor | Informed: Lauren Bishop

Open questions / asks for ClearLake team:
1) Can you confirm primary ClearLake owner for security (name + email) so we can loop in SOC2 evidence and KMS key scope?
2) Is the procurement contact above correct for contract/PO timelines?
3) Any blackout dates in Mar/Apr that would impact the proposed kickoff?

Next steps from Redwood by EOD Friday: finalize the PoC plan doc (attached) and send calendar invites for kickoff pending your confirmation of owners.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole

Hi all — thanks for the clear notes. Quick technical points on the proposed plan: 
- For VPC setup we recommend using our private connector; it reduces setup time compared to on-prem package and still meets PHI/KMS requirements.
- We'll provide a pre-built deployment image for the dedicated test pool. Expect 2-3 hours to stand up once we have credentials.
- Latency target: we'll aim for <250ms median 95th with a 1k token response on the dedicated test pool; we'll validate under expected concurrency using our load harness.
- Telemetry: we'll enable request-level audit logs and a token-level breakdown in the Redwood Console; Neha will manage the SOC2 artifact handoff.

Draft technical RACI (slightly more detailed):
- Redwood: provision dedicated test pool (Responsible: Vivek), provide deployment image & run initial smoke tests (Accountable: Vivek), share telemetry configs with Neha (Consulted: Neha).
- ClearLake: provide VPC peering info and credentials (Responsible: David), provide staging app integration point & test data (Responsible: Samantha).

I'll attach a short ops checklist to the thread (attached).
